rows.grounds: compound of śiras, vadana, hṛd, guhya, pāda, and deśa indicating a series of bodily locations
indeclinable adverbial expression indicating sequential correspondence

items.question: Which bodily locations correspond sequentially to the previously named elements?
premises: A sequence of bodily locations is specified.
The locations named are head, face, heart, secret part, and feet.
The correspondence follows the stated order.
items.inference: The previously enumerated elements are assigned respectively to the head, face, heart, secret part, and feet.
uncertainties: The specific elements being assigned depend on the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: In the regions of the head, face, heart, secret part, and feet, in due order.
